details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3052) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using command-scoped `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in subprocess argv, process listings, Git remote configuration, diagnostics, and error output; moonshotai_kimi-k3 additionally reports that the `GH_PAT` fallback was removed.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-180), _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 564-606), and deleted _memory_git helper | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, leaving unauthenticated bare git operations while force-tick remotes embed credentials in URLs.
  WHY: `persist-credentials: false` causes branch operations to fail and fail open, while token-bearing URLs leak through argv and temporary `.git/config`.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:deleted is_sensitive_target_path (previously lines 155-168), normalize_path (lines 240-247), and emit_context raw-path loop (line 568) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was deleted and `emit_context` resolves raw paths without normalization.
  WHY: Inputs such as `.git/config`, `.env.production`, and `.ssh/id_rsa` can reach filesystem reads and model context, exposing credentials and Git metadata.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 664 (`codex --sandbox danger-full-access`) and lines 210-215 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase bypasses the model-provider broker and invokes Codex with the real `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and `--sandbox danger-full-access`.
  WHY: Issue-derived synthesis gains workspace write access and direct provider credentials instead of the documented ephemeral-token, read-only boundary.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:REST projection at lines 768-769 and GraphQL projection at lines 833-841, 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Comment projections drop `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked marker and approval authentication and review-thread resolution require those fields, so valid requests and approvals cannot be identified.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_signal_child_group early return at lines 406-407; _kill_child_group_if_running at lines 439-448; idle SIGKILL gate at lines 560-567 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Privileged SIGKILL is skipped when the tracked sudo wrapper has exited even if isolated descendants remain.
  WHY: SIGTERM can reap the wrapper while SIGTERM-ignoring `nobody` descendants survive, leaving the isolated editor process group alive.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_signal_child_group at lines 404-436 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The privileged signalling path can return success after `sudo -n kill` fails without setting `signal_failure` when the group is no longer observed.
  WHY: A genuine privileged-signal failure can be treated as successful; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and moonshotai_kimi-k3 disagree about related `PermissionError` behavior, reporting the non-isolated path as fail-closed.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:terminate_editor_attempt_process_group at lines 292-333 and watchdog call sites at lines 2178 and 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The fallback path kills only the runner-owned guard when metadata or privileged signalling is unavailable, while watchdog callers discard the failure with `|| true`.
  WHY: The isolated editor group can survive until orphan cleanup, while cleanup refuses to restore workspace ownership.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines 326-329 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The non-isolated guard TERM-to-KILL grace was reduced from 5 seconds to 1 second.
  WHY: The guard's delayed kill timer may not forward SIGKILL before the guard itself is killed, allowing non-isolated descendants to survive.
- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh:editor_isolation_signal_process_group at lines 108-148 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: A failed `sudo -n kill` can be treated as success if the group disappears during the subsequent `pgrep` check.
  WHY: A real sudoers or signalling failure is masked by a TOCTOU race; the reviewers consistently identify this as a fail-open path.
- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh:editor_isolation_verify_process_group_stopped at lines 167-187 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Verification treats nonstandard `pgrep` failures as successful process-group termination.
  WHY: Transient process-table failures can allow cleanup to chown the workspace while an isolated process remains.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_isolated_group_has_members at lines 356-373 and _verify_isolated_group_stopped at lines 384-394 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `pgrep` error statuses and zombie processes are not distinguished from live process-group members.
  WHY: Verification can falsely report survivors or success on process-table errors; the reviewers disagree on which nonzero status is interpreted as success versus membership.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:entire file now ends at line 140; removed model_provider_broker_* functions previously at lines 141-481 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker helper family was deleted while unchanged callers remain.
  WHY: Model-dependent workflows running under `set -e` abort with `command not found` before model startup, removing the documented credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:removed review_blocked_* helper family at lines 950-1352 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval, successor, and terminal-flow helpers were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Approval, merge, follow-up, and reissue flows abort with `command not found`.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:removed git_with_github_auth at lines 496-508 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while judge-fix and baseline-push callers remain.
  WHY: Those pushes fail with `command not found` or without authentication.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:removed `--provider-base-url` option at lines 105-112 and hardcoded `base_url` at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The documented `--provider-base-url` option was removed while existing callers still pass it.
  WHY: Configuration exits with an unknown-argument error before model startup; hardcoding the public endpoint also bypasses loopback broker URL injection.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 30, 37, 714, 716, 776, 779, 781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were deleted.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError` before targeted-context tests run.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context at lines 536+, 540-545, 562-564 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now returns a header and disabled marker instead of an empty string.
  WHY: Callers and tests using zero as the disable switch receive non-empty targeted context.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context at lines 549, 556-559, 564-575, 576-579, 583-628 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Path-count, per-path byte, summary-reserve, and marker budget accounting were removed.
  WHY: Missing or invalid path lists can produce output beyond `max_bytes`, and overflow summaries can push rendered context past the configured limit.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 59-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Artifact cleanup now checks index membership and restores only the worktree, removing staged restoration and cached removal.
  WHY: A staged modification, deletion, or new file can remain in the index and enter the next implementation commit unintentionally.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Give the stall guard a privileged kill path when the editor is isolated: when the launched command starts with `sudo -n -u <user>`, signal the group via `sudo -n kill -<SIG> -- -<pgid>` ... including after the sudo wrapper exits, and treat `PermissionError` as a hard, logged failure. Keep the existing behaviour for non-isolated callers."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh::_signal_child_group, _kill_child_group_if_running, and idle SIGKILL gate at lines 560-567
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The privileged path exists but returns on `child.poll() is not None` without signalling survivors; `PermissionError` handling is disputed; the non-isolated watchdog grace was reduced from 5 seconds to 1 second.
- requirement: "Make the `review_apply_fixes.sh` watchdog kill the editor's process group the same privileged way (and only then the guard), so a wall-time or idle kill actually stops opencode before cleanup_editor_isolation chowns the workspace back."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh::terminate_editor_attempt_process_group and background watchdog at lines 2170-2200
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The fallback kills only the guard, watchdog calls use `|| true`, and the TERM-to-KILL grace changed from 5 seconds to 1 second.
- requirement: "Add a contract test under `tests/` pinning that the isolated launch and the guard's kill path agree on the privileged signal mechanism."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py and tests/test_editor_isolation_preflight.py
  confide
